cases.name: Fully supported answer
cases.description: Question that has clear, complete supporting evidence in the corpus
cases.question: What is supervised learning?

cases.name: Partially supported answer
cases.description: Question where only part of the answer is in the corpus
cases.question: Describe BERT's architecture and its training dataset size.
cases.limitation: Training dataset size is not in the corpus

cases.name: No supporting evidence
cases.description: Question on a topic completely absent from the corpus
cases.question: What is the capital city of France?

cases.name: Conflicting evidence
cases.description: Corpus contains contradictory information about a topic
cases.question: Is a high learning rate always better for faster training?
cases.note: The corpus shows both harms: too large = divergence, too small = slow convergence

cases.name: Misleading distractor
cases.description: Query uses terminology from corpus but the specific claim is not supported
cases.question: Do CNNs use self-attention mechanisms like transformers?
cases.note: CNNs use convolutional filters (doc_C_c0), transformers use self-attention (doc_B_c0). CNNs do NOT use self-attention.

metadata.description: Grounding benchmark cases for AXIOM Phase 8. Tests evidence retrieval, claim support, citation validity, and uncertainty expression.
